name: Merluko
backstory: A smith in Gorff who went short of iron three seasons running during the years Terfila's fleets pressed the toll - before Auroboro's raid broke it.

criterion.standard: counts the arrears actually paid above another season of 'the count's been difficult'
criterion.wasted_life: the same forge going short again, not from a blockade this time but from money that's owed and simply isn't arriving
criterion.derivation: collision between his backstory (a smith who went short of iron for years during the old blockade) and the sample's own toll_ledger_arrears (Gorff's own money going unpaid again, for a different reason)
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

history.note: re-derived after encodings.json gained three new concrete concepts (crossing_market_roof, toll_ledger_arrears, forliamus_betrothal_offer) via /tell, at the author's explicit direction, to diversify arcs away from the epistemic-conflict default

routines.routine_actions: sells iron work at the market through the day, still counts every delivery against the lean seasons he remembers, never quite trusts a supply line to hold

arc.premise: With the arrears finally being chased by someone who has to answer for it, Merluko wants a forward contract for his own iron deliveries locked in too, so the next disruption - whatever it turns out to be - doesn't catch his forge short the way the old blockade did.
